summary: The manager has adopted a policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the components of the underlying index and in derivatives and other investments that have economic characteristics similar to the components of the underlying index. The underlying index may include common stocks, ordinary shares, ADR, shares of beneficial interest or limited partnership interests and tracking stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
